notes.title: Content patch, 1st Linux build and Sunken Steam Sale are now live!
notes.notes:
Okay, first things first: we did not want to go on a sale, and we never really intended to back down, but we were very strongly advised to do so, and with Christmas coming up, we really wanted more people to play Sunken, so we caved in – Sunken joins the Steam Sale! We are hoping that this will mean a lot to some, and that others, who did not expect this game to go on a sale, will forgive us. We have to tell those of you who supported us thus far: thank you! You have been the best crowd!
Now that we got that our of our way – new content! As we said in our previous announcement, we added a new mode – Eternal Torment. It has vastly sped-up gameplay, randomized dungeons and there is no crafting in this mode. You will find things like enchanting, re-speccing, hunting for objectives and lootable objects in here. Also, there is a map! Since many of you asked for it, we implemented it in this mode.We hope you find it a lot of fun like we did!
Finally, a Linux build. As we already said, 32 and 64 tested on Ubuntu 15.10. We are hoping it will work fine, because we haven’t tested it on too many machines.
Cheers to all, and Merry Christmas guys!

notes.title: UPCOMING CONTENT PATCH AND LINUX BUILD!
notes.notes:
Hello everyone!

       We heard your invaluable suggestions and ideas, and we sat down to think it through very thoroughly! And we made a completely new mode for you, and it will be coming before Christmas! 

      Eternal Torment is the name of the new mode in which you can show off your true power, run through randomly generated levels with random quests, enchant your items and explode giant groups of mobs  while taking names!

       Skip crafting all together in this mode getting direct skill drops dozens of random items and no crafting materials to clutter your loot bags! In this mode you have a map that many of you asked for, the game-play speed is almost doubled and there is no perma-death you just get back up on your feet and keep killing! If you don't like your build in this mode you can hit the respec button at any point! 

      Along with this patch we will include linux build as well (32 and 64 tested on Ubuntu 15.10) . We hope to be able to cover other platforms as well soon! 

Cheers guys thank you for supporting us so far and keep being awesome! :)

notes.title: Patch notes! #4
notes.notes:
Firstly sorry for so many patches, but adding things > not adding things, right? :)

- Auto-attack combo! We have noticed that many people point out that auto attack doesn't have enough of a satisfying feeling so we introduced a combo system for it! We have three different animations now (that have different hit-boxes!) that cycle through, attack speed has been slightly increased and audio-visual media has been partially reworked on auto-attack! :)
- Additionally, Gula's damage has been slightly nerfed (we almost got the torches and pitchforks with all the people dying at Gula) so you should be able to put him back in his place! :)
- Minor bug fixes.
Happy Hunting, Gang! :)

notes.title: Patch notes! #3
notes.notes:
- Cursor visibility slightly improved, may be even further accentuated if necessary.
- Added journal entries in the main menu!
- Fixed some path-finding issues related to the recent rework regarding mob-pushing.
- Global settings for all saves introduced!
- When you have loot open, hitting space will automatically loot all it can now!
- Minor bug fixes.

Edit: Included 16:10 resolutions. If any bugs arise from that do let us know! :)

notes.title: Patch notes! #2
notes.notes:
- Bug with an empty item slot duplication should be fixed now.
- FPS capped to 120 unless vsync is on, in that case vsync takes over.
- Current score on death is now shown.
- Full inventory issue with stacking items has been solved.
- Abilities rebound keys now show properly.
- Better indication for right click.
- Leaderboards now show exact placing. (Previously it was relative to your surroundings).
- "Mob pushing" has now been disabled.
- Minor bug fixes.

Issues that had not been touched upon and are to come in the next patch:
- Better cursor visibility.
- Unlocked Lore Books will be available in main menu.
- Per save settings will be swapped with global settings.

Thank you all for being patient and showing so much support! :)
